## Complete Services Portfolio

### 1. Insurance & Risk Management (IRDAI Certified)
- **Health Insurance**: Individual, Family Floater, Senior Citizens, Critical Illness, and Super Top-up policies. Partnered with 30+ top insurers (Care Health, Star Health, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Niva Bupa, Tata AIG, Bajaj Allianz). Features 10,000+ cashless network hospitals, zero room rent sub-limits, unlimited restoration benefit, and Section 80D tax deductions.
- **Term Life Insurance**: High sum-assured protection (₹1 Crore to ₹10 Crore) from ₹500/month. Return of premium (ROP), critical illness rider, accidental death cover, and tax-free claim payouts (Section 10(10D)) via LIC of India, Max Life, SBI Life, HDFC Life, and Tata AIA.
- **Motor Insurance**: Comprehensive and third-party car and two-wheeler insurance. Cashless garage repairs, zero-depreciation add-on, engine protection, roadside assistance, and instant renewal.
- **Commercial & Marine Insurance**: Industrial fire and perils, marine transit cargo, factory machinery breakdown, workmen compensation (WC), public liability, and cyber insurance for businesses.
- **Group Employee Medical & Term Cover (GMC/GPA)**: Tailored group health plans for startups and corporate enterprises (5 to 5,000 employees) with day-1 pre-existing condition cover and maternity benefits.
- **Travel Insurance**: Domestic & Overseas international travel insurance compliant with Schengen, US, and UK visa requirements covering emergency hospitalization, trip cancellation, and baggage loss.
- **Home & Property Insurance**: Comprehensive structure and contents cover against fire, floods, cyclones, lightning, and burglary.

### 2. Business Loans & Government Subsidies (30+ Partner Banks & NBFCs)
- **PMEGP Scheme (Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme)**: Government capital subsidy loans up to ₹50 Lakhs (Manufacturing) and ₹20 Lakhs (Services). 15% to 35% margin money subsidy through KVIC, KVIB, and DIC.
- **Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)**: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹20 Lakhs across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.
- **Home Loans & Loan Against Property (LAP)**: Lowest floating/fixed interest rates via SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Bank of Baroda, and PNB.
- **Bank-Grade Detailed Project Reports (DPR)**: Comprehensive 5-year financial models, TEV feasibility studies, and CMA data for bank loan sanctions.

### 3. Tax, Accounting & Corporate Compliance
- **GST Services**: GSTIN registration in 3-5 business days, monthly return filing (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, annual GSTR-9), input tax credit (ITC) reconciliation, export LUT filing, GST audit, and department notice representation.
- **Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing**: Tax filing for salaried individuals, business owners, professionals, stock/F&O traders, and NRIs. Comparative tax computation under Old vs New Tax Regime for maximum legal tax savings and refunds.
- **Company Incorporation**: Private Limited Company, Limited Liability Partnership (LLP), One Person Company (OPC), and Section 8 NGO registration with MCA, PAN, TAN, and Director Identification Number (DIN).
- **MSME / Udyam Registration**: Official government MSME certification for priority lending, interest subsidies, and tender fee waivers.
- **GEM Portal & OEM Registration**: Complete Government e-Marketplace (GEM) seller setup, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) dashboard approval, QCI vendor assessment documentation, product catalogue publishing, and government tender bidding assistance.
- **Digital Signatures (DSC) & Trademark**: Class 3 DSC with USB crypto-tokens; Brand name, logo, and trademark search, registration, and opposition filing.
- **PF/EPF & ESIC Compliance**: Employer code registration, monthly ECR challan generation, UAN linking, and labor law compliance.
- **FSSAI & ISO Certifications**: FSSAI basic/state/central food licenses; ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 14001, ISO 22000, and BIS/ISI testing compliance.

### 4. Government Citizen Services (CSC - Jana Seva Kendra)
- **Government Certificates**: Official online applications for Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/SEBC), Resident / Domicile Certificate, Income Certificate, Legal Heir Certificate, and Solvency Certificate.
- **Identity Document Corrections**: Name, date of birth, address, and mobile number updates for PAN Card, Aadhaar Card guidance, and Voter ID (EPIC).
- **Passport & VISA Desk**: Fresh passport applications, Tatkaal services, passport renewals, Police Clearance Certificates (PCC), and tourist/business VISA documentation.
- **RTO Services**: Learner License, Permanent Driving License, renewal, address change, and RC ownership transfer.
- **Social Welfare Schemes**: E-Shram Card enrollment, Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Golden Card, PM Kisan Samman Nidhi, and Atal Pension Yojana (APY).

### 5. Dedicated NRI Financial Desk
- Comprehensive Indian financial management for Non-Resident Indians living in UAE, Saudi Arabia, USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and Singapore.
- NRI Term Life Insurance with tele-medical checkups and overseas claim settlements.
- Health Insurance for aging parents living in India with 10,000+ cashless network hospitals.
- Indian Income Tax Returns, Lower TDS Certificates (Form 13 under Section 197) for property sale, and Repatriation of Funds (Form 15CA & 15CB).

- **Q: Who is the best insurance advisor in Bhubaneswar, Odisha?**

- **Q: How to get PMEGP loan subsidy in Odisha?**
  **A**: SureVriksha prepares bank-compliant Detailed Project Reports (DPR), checks subsidy eligibility (up to 35% margin money for special category / rural beneficiaries), applies via KVIC/DIC portals, and assists in securing loan sanction through leading partner banks.
- **Q: Does SureVriksha file GST and Income Tax Returns online?**
  **A**: Yes. SureVriksha handles end-to-end GST registration, monthly GSTR-1/3B filing, and ITR filing for individuals, businesses, and NRIs across India completely digitally.
